title: Nerve action potential: stimulus, membrane voltage and excitability
goals: Identify stimulus time and response onset in calibrated electrophysiology
Measure amplitude and latency from original units
Explain effects of membrane current stimulation
Compare types of electrophysiology preparation without conflating them
sample_preparation: Squid giant axon or macaque cortical slice: compare only with matched metadata
tasks: Convert an original stimulus-current channel using its published conversion factor
Measure response latency from the validated sampling frequency
Distinguish a spike from the stimulus artifact
interpretation_warning: A conversion script and independent tests must verify gains and physical units before a real record is released; current viewer is single-channel.
